newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Assad, Italy's Prodi discuss Mideast peace.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad, Italy's Prodi discuss Mideast peace.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad and Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi discussed the latest developments in the Middle East peace process during a telephone conversation on Tuesday, presidential spokesman Joubran Kourieh said.
Kourieh said the two leaders also discussed other matters of common interest.

Syria has been urging Europe, along with the United States, to play a bigger role in the peace process, and to persuade Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to return the Golan Heights, captured in the 1967 Middle East war, in exchange for peace with Syria.
